verse.verse_1: Have you seen one who denies the Day of Judgement?
verse.verse_3: and who does not urge the feeding of the poor?
verse.verse_4: So woe to those who pray
verse.verse_5: but whose hearts are not in their prayer.
verse.verse_6: Those who do things only to be seen by others.
verse.verse_7: Who are uncharitable even over very small things.
